title: Wicked Fishing Charters
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Lousiana is famous for its variety of fish species. On this trip, Captain Mack will bring you to fish for Redfish, Sheepshead, Speckled Trout, and plenty of others! Load up a cooler of fish and have a memorable day on the water.

quotes.text: Captain Mack. got us on fish first thing in the morning. If the fishing slowed down in that spot, he knew where to go. and kept us on fish all day. 40” 18.5lbs red was the biggest fish of the day, what a great experience. Don’t hesitate about booking your trip here. He is fast to respond!!!!

This was an awesome day with Mackie. We absolutely loved every minute of it. We caught some awesome fish. Hit the Grand Slam! We caught several alligator gar, shark, and bull red. Could not have asked for a prettier day nor a better Captain. Thank you so much!! The Robbins Family
Mackie is great guide. He has awesome gear and knows how to put you on fish. Took my boy out for his first Redfish and trout. Lots of fish and a great time.
